study_id: Shaw et al. - 2023 - Multicenter analysis of immunosuppressive medications on the risk of malignancy following adult soli

eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study involves adult heart and lung transplant recipients and uses a random forest AI model, but it lacks a comparator against current clinical practice, which is required for inclusion.

identification_methods.Setting: Multicenter academic hospitals in the greater Chicago area
identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective cohort study using EHR data from three academic hospitals (Loyola University Medical Center, Gottlieb Memorial Hospital, MacNeal Hospital) covering 2000‑2021.
identification_methods.Dataset Source: Electronic health record from three hospitals
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Included adult patients ≥18 years; identified transplants and malignancies via ICD‑9/10 codes.
identification_methods.Input Variables: Demographics (age, sex, race, ethnicity, zip code), transplant organ type, immunosuppressive medication regimens (type, start/end dates), total number of medications.
identification_methods.Validation Method: Bootstrap resampling 10 times stratified by outcome (internal validation).
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Random forest variable importance; one‑hot encoding and normalization of variables; time‑dependent covariates in Cox proportional hazards models.

population.Inclusion criteria: Adult solid organ transplant recipients (age ≥18 years)
population.Population Notes: Retrospective multicenter cohort from three academic hospitals in Chicago, United States, EHR data queried 2000-2021

interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: Electronic health record data including ICD codes, demographics, transplant dates, and immunosuppressive medication records
interventions_outcomes.Feature Selection Method: Variable importance from random forest (Gini impurity) and Cox multivariate regression
interventions_outcomes.Temporal Handling: Time-dependent covariates for immunosuppressive medications in Cox proportional hazards models
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Retrospective multicenter cohort; immunosuppressive medications treated as time-varying exposures
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Post‑transplant malignancy incidence, hazard ratios for specific immunosuppressive agents
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Includes overall malignancy, skin cancer, lymphoma, organ‑specific cancers; reported as hazard ratios
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: Random forest used to assess variable importance; Cox regression provided HRs for each medication
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome group: All solid organ transplant recipients in the cohort (n=5,591)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reporting: HR for tacrolimus = 0.59 (95% CI 0.44–0.81, p<0.001); other meds reported similarly
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: Hazard ratio from multivariate Cox proportional hazards model
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: Risk varies by immunosuppressive agent: sirolimus, azathioprine, cyclosporine increase risk; tacrolimus decreases risk
